verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a dedicated Sandbox environment with its own signup, base URL (api-sandbox.mercury.com), pre-loaded dummy data, and explicit no-real-money guarantee, plus a note that production tokens don't work there — directly matching the story of testing without touching production data. The 'test safely in sandbox, then swap one URL for production' messaging and separate OAuth2-sandbox base URL further corroborate this as a first-class, documented workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation that the sandbox behaves as documented (only vendor docs support this, no community verification found).
